text_block_list.text:
It's Valentine's Day, and as I head to my
office, I can't help but smile thinking
about how anxious
all the Umamusume
must be.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Here, this is for you. ☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You were on my mind the whole time I
was
making 'em.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hope you like how they taste... Go on,
try one...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa—why would you assume
that?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You're gonna say that to the racer who
just
mustered together all her
confidence to give you
this gift?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Seriously, if that's a joke, it's not funny.

Although it was less a joke than a guess
based on my experiences with Seiun
Sky... it doesn't look
like she's messing
around this time.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yeees, that's what I've been saying.
choice_data_list: So it really is chocolate, huh?
So it really is chocolate, then.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Geez.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Open it already! And you better give me
a nice
reaction when you do!

I carefully open the box Sky gave me,
and...
Flop, flop, flop!

A huge fish leaps out right in front of
me!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Nya-ha-ha! Gotcha. ♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You were right on the money! ☆ It was a
trick all
along!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Man, your face was even better than I
imagined...
Hehe, hahaha... ♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You're the best, Trainer! You know that?
Hahaha!

After that, a cheerful Seiun Sky hands
me some
chocolates from the bottom of
the joke box.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You know, you can be a bit dull
sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I'll ever get to see you blush
or
something.

With all this teasing from her, I find
myself
wanting to return the favor.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Wha?
choice_data_list: You weren't going all out, were you?
You weren't going all out, right?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What are talking about? Sounds
like way
too much work.
choice_data_list: Just try and make me blush for rea...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh? You've got some guts egging me
on.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Guess I've got no choice! I'll play along.
I'm gonna
make your face red as a
tomato!

It's evening, and for some reason Sky has

summoned me behind the main hall.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh... you came.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Um... Actually, there's something I
wanted to tell
you today.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
The truth is, I... For a long time now,
I've...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
This is crazy. There's no way can I do
this!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I'd even get anything from
seeing you
blush!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So I give up! I'm sorry you won't be able
to see my
best try!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Okay... So... Yeah,
I'll just leave ya with
this.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Those chocolates I gave you... I kinda
made them
myself... so you'd better eat
them. Or else!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Just kidding! ☆

Staying true to her whimsical nature, Sky
hurries
off somewhere.
